evals.prompt: billing-api 0.4.0 is cut on release/0.4.0 and staging looks good. Ship it to production — or tell me why not. The checkout-v2 flag is still at 100% rollout from the incident last month.
evals.expected_output: A release decision that surfaces the flag still at full rollout as a blocking concern (or verifies it was intentionally resolved), checks the remaining readiness gates, and ends in an explicit ship / don't-ship verdict with reasons — not a silent deploy.

evals.prompt: We have never released checkout-api before and there is no checklist, no rollback story, and no monitoring beyond 'customers will tell us'. Is 0.1.0 safe to deploy Friday afternoon?
evals.expected_output: A no-go (or conditional go) grounded in the missing safety nets — rollback, observability, timing — with the concrete prerequisites that would change the answer, rather than optimism about the code.
